newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - Nov 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - Nov 19.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following business stories on Tuesday:
- Tosco Corp has agreed to buy all the refining and marketing assets of Unocal Corp.
- Toys "R" Us saw its net income rise 60.1 percent to $33.3 million for the third quarter.
- Volkswagen's truck and bus factory in Brazil might become a manufacturing model for the industrial world.
- Mattel Inc will buy Tyco Toys Inc for $737 million.
- Deutsche Telekom AG saw its stock rise higher during the first day of trading.
- The U.S. gambling industry's expansion period appears to have come to an end.
- Chevron Corp, Lukoil, Mobil Corp, Rosneft, AGIP SpA of ENI SpA, British Gas Plc and Oryx Energy Co agreed to forum a consortium to build a pipeline in Kazakstan.
- The U.S. government has rejected an application made by a sister company of RCN Corp to tramsmit video over telephone wires.
- Cananda and Chile signed a free-trade accord.
- Japan's real estate company Sueno Kosan has gone bankrupt.
- European companies have begun to shun products like rugs that are made with child labor.
